sources.notes: ACE-Ego-0 uses the current terms reliability-aware weighting, camera-space actions, morphology conditioning, and time-aligned action chunking for heterogeneous human/robot/simulation pretraining.
ActiveMimic treats egocentric camera motion as a viewpoint action rather than nuisance noise.
HumanEgo foregrounds entity-level hand-object interaction and transfer across novel robots, cameras, and environments.
Gemini Robotics 1.5 uses motion transfer terminology for heterogeneous multi-embodiment robot data.
